construction_notes.text: Imported from the state Housing Element Annual Progress Report, which cities file themselves and which runs through 2025. Not yet checked against the city's own project list.

San Francisco YIMBY (May 2026) on 951 Old County Road: 63 units, eight stories, CRP Affordable Housing and Community Development; City of Belmont approved an additional $2 million. County parcel data shows 951 Old County Rd on a separate parcel, 040-313-430.

CTCAC CA-25-689: The Ridge at Ralston, located at 678 Ralston Avenue in Belmont on a 0.36 acre site, requested and is being recommended for a reservation of $2,597,613 in annual federal tax credits, $6,000,000 in total state tax credits, and $16,000,000 of tax-exempt bond cap to finance the new construction of 65 units of housing, consisting of 64 restricted rental units and 1 unrestricted manager's unit. Recorded as a note because this funding covers The Ridge at Ralston (65 units), which may be one component of this record.

CTCAC application CA-26-546, The Ridge on Masonic: 63 total units, 62 low-income, 951 Old County Road, APN 040-313-430. Application, not an award: bond request $15,800,000, federal credit request $2,477,079 (CDLAC May 19, 2026 applicant list).
San Mateo County AHF predevelopment pipeline, September 2024: Ridge at Ralston (Abode/CRP Dev.): 64 total units, 26% at 15-30% AMI, 55% at 31-60%, 19% at 61-80%.
Split: The Ridge on Masonic (951 Old County Rd, APN 040-313-430) now has its own record. The 951 Old County address and combined state rows remain here as imported.
